lines.text: The Teacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem and set his mind to explore by wisdom all that is done under heaven.
The Teacher found all things done under the sun to be a pursuit of the wind, and with much wisdom comes much sorrow.
The Teacher tested himself with pleasure, called laughter folly, and cheered his body with milk while his mind guided him with wisdom.
He built houses, planted vineyards, made gardens, and gathered silver and gold, and he became greater than all who preceded him in Bethlehem.
He denied himself no pleasure, yet he found everything futile and there was nothing to be gained under the sun.
